spells.name: Undead Ward
spells.description: Creates a 10ft radius ward around the caster. Undead must make a WIS saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or be unable to enter the warded area. Does not destroy or turn undead — only prevents entry.
spells.author_note: Fifteen years perfecting it. It worked perfectly and solved nothing — his companions were already inside the ward when they became undead.

spells.name: Starfall
spells.description:
Call down a beam of starlight on any point visible to you within range. All creatures within a 10-foot radius of that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d6 radiant damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is not blinded.
The impact point becomes Starfall Ground — a 10-foot radius patch of solidified starlight that persists for 1 minute. Creatures moving through Starfall Ground take 2d6 radiant damage and have their movement speed halved until the start of their next turn.
This spell can only be cast once per dawn. It does not consume a spell slot.
spells.source: Homebrew — Ring of the Fallen Star

spells.name: Smite From Afar
spells.description: Until the end of your turn, the next thrown or ranged weapon attack you make deals an additional 1d8 damage. Roll 1d8 to determine the damage type: 1 — Fire, 2 — Cold, 3 — Lightning, 4 — Thunder, 5 — Acid, 6 — Poison, 7 — Radiant, 8 — Force. This spell expends a spell slot as normal.

features.name: Infuse Item
features.source: TCoE — Artificer
features.description: At the end of a long rest, touch nonmagical objects and infuse them with magic. Each infusion can only be in one object at a time. If you try to exceed your infusion limit, the oldest infusion ends. Infusions last until you die, at which point they fade at the next dawn. Number of infusions known and active scale with artificer level.

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.source: TCoE — Artificer
features.description: You can attune to up to 4 magic items at once. If you craft a magic item that is a common or uncommon item, it takes you a quarter of the normal time and costs half as much gold.

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.source: TCoE — Artillerist
features.description: Use your action and expend a spell slot to create a magical cannon in an unoccupied space on a horizontal surface within 5ft of you. The cannon is a magical object of size Small that has AC 18 and HP equal to 5 times your artificer level. It is immune to poison and psychic damage. If it drops to 0hp it explodes — each creature within 5ft makes a DEX save DC equal to your spell save DC or takes 3d8 force damage, half on success. As a bonus action command the cannon to activate. It disappears after 1 hour, when reduced to 0hp, or when you create another. You can have two cannons simultaneously at level 6. Choose one of three modes when creating:

modes.name: Flamethrower
modes.description: 15ft cone. Each creature makes DEX save or takes 2d8 fire damage, half on success. Ignites unattended flammable objects.

modes.name: Force Ballista
modes.description: Ranged spell attack using your spell attack modifier. Range 120ft. On hit: 2d8 force damage and target pushed 5ft away.

modes.name: Protector
modes.description: Emits a burst of positive energy. You and all allies within 10ft of the cannon gain temporary HP equal to 1d8 plus your INT modifier.

features.note: For Jaygar specifically, his custom alchemical heavy crossbow serves as his Eldritch Cannon in Force Ballista mode. The crossbow is the cannon.

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.source: TCoE — Artillerist
features.description: You know how to turn a wand, staff, or rod into an arcane firearm, a conduit for your destructive spells. When you finish a long rest, you can use woodcarver's tools to carve special sigils into a wand, staff, or rod and thereby turn it into your arcane firearm. The sigils disappear from the object if you later carve them on a different item. The sigils otherwise last indefinitely. You can use your arcane firearm as a spellcasting focus for your artificer spells. When you cast an artificer spell through the firearm, roll a d8 and you gain a bonus to one of the spell's damage rolls equal to the number rolled.
features.note: For Jaygar specifically, his custom alchemical heavy crossbow is his arcane firearm. Homebrew extension of the feature from wand/staff/rod to crossbow to fit his established character concept.

features.name: Fortified Position
features.source: TCoE — Artillerist
features.description: You're a master at forming well-defended emplacements using Eldritch Cannon. You and your allies have half cover while within 10ft of a cannon you create with Eldritch Cannon, taking into account only cannon that you can see. Also, when you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with a single activation of one of your cannons, rather than requiring a bonus action.
features.note: Jaygar gains this at level 9. Currently level 8 — not yet available but close.

features.name: Infusion: Repeating Shot
features.source: TCoE — Artificer
features.item_requirement: A simple or martial weapon with the ammunition property
features.description: The weapon requires no ammunition. It produces its own magical ammunition when used. The weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls unless it already has a bonus to those rolls. The ammunition produced by the weapon vanishes the instant after it hits or misses a target.

features.name: Infusion: Enhanced Arcane Focus
features.source: TCoE — Artificer
features.description: While holding this item, a creature gains a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. At artificer level 10 this increases to +2. The holder also ignores half cover when making spell attacks.
features.note: For Jaygar applied to his crossbow as arcane firearm — bonus increases to +2 at level 10.

features.name: Infusion: Armor of Magical Strength
features.source: TCoE — Artificer
features.description: This armor has 6 charges. The wearer can use the armor's charges in the following ways: spend 1 charge as a reaction when the wearer fails a STR check or saving throw to add their INT modifier to the total, potentially turning the failure into a success. Spend 1 charge as a reaction when the wearer would be knocked prone to instead remain standing. The armor regains 1d6 charges daily at dawn.

features.name: Infusion: Lantern of Revealing
features.source: TCoE — Artificer
features.description: While lit this lantern sheds bright light in a 30ft radius and dim light for an additional 30ft. Invisible creatures and objects within the bright light area are revealed — they are visible and can be seen clearly for the duration the lantern remains lit. The lantern burns for 6 hours on a flask of oil.

features.name: Artillerist Bonus Spells
features.source: TCoE — Artillerist
features.description: You always have the following spells prepared. They do not count against the number of artificer spells you can prepare. If you gain an artillerist spell that does not appear on the artificer spell list, the spell is nonetheless an artificer spell for you.

features.name: Bladesong
features.description: You invoke an ancient elven magic as a bonus action. While active (up to 1 minute), you gain a bonus to AC equal to your INT modifier, your walking speed increases by 10 ft, you have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and you gain a bonus to Constitution saves to maintain concentration equal to your INT modifier. Ends early if you are incapacitated, don medium or heavy armor or a shield, or use two hands to make an attack. 2 uses, regained on a short or long rest.

features.name: Totemic Assault
features.description: When hitting with a weapon or cantrip, channel spirit energy for 1d8 lightning or cold damage.

features.name: Life Bearer
features.description: When casting a healing spell, add WIS modifier to the healing done.

features.name: Totemic Blessing
features.description: Bind any totem and use its effect as a bonus action when healing an ally.

features.name: Spirit Communion
features.description: Once per long rest, speak directly with any spirit within one mile, asking three questions.

features.name: Sacred Focus: Mind
features.description: Add WIS modifier to Intelligence and Charisma checks and saving throws.

features.name: Dagger of Swift Strike
features.description: Once per turn on a hit with this dagger, immediately make a second strike with it as part of the same attack. No bonus action required.
features.note: Item feature, not a class feature — stored here because it has a rules definition that needs to be referenced.

features.name: Tactical Foresight
features.description: When using Master of Tactics Help action, target two allies instead of one. Each gains a bonus to their next saving throw equal to the user's INT modifier.

features.name: Commander's Presence
features.description: Passive aura, 30ft radius. Allies within range gain +1 to AC and +1 to all saving throws from Torrin's constant tactical whispers, threat assessment, and battlefield positioning advice. Does not require an action or concentration.

features.name: The Retired Special
features.description: Once per day, reaction when an ally is hit: toss a psychic thread and pull the ally up to 15ft to an unoccupied space, potentially causing the attack to miss.

features.name: Grandmaster's Stitch
features.description: During a long rest, touch a leather armor or leather item. That item becomes infused for 24 hours — wearer gains resistance to Psychic damage and advantage on saving throws against Charmed and Frightened.

features.name: Sentinel
features.description: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, its speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn. Creatures provoke opportunity attacks even if they took the Disengage action. When a creature within 5ft attacks a target other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

features.name: Dual Wielder
features.description: +1 AC while wielding a melee weapon in each hand. Can use two-weapon fighting with non-light weapons. Can draw or stow two weapons at once.

features.name: Great Weapon Master
features.description: On a critical hit or killing blow with a heavy melee weapon: make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action. Before making a melee attack with a heavy weapon: take -5 to hit for +10 damage.
features.note: Decide before the roll whether to use the -5/+10 option.

features.name: Sharpshooter
features.description: Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage. Ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover. Before making a ranged attack: take -5 to hit for +10 damage.
features.note: Decide before the roll whether to use the -5/+10 option.

features.name: War Caster
features.description: Advantage on CON saving throws to maintain concentration. Can perform somatic components with hands full. Can cast a spell as an opportunity attack — must target only the provoking creature, casting time must be 1 action.

features.name: Mobile
features.description: +10ft movement speed. Difficult terrain doesn't cost extra movement when you Dash. When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn regardless of hit or miss.

features.name: Observant
features.description: +5 passive Perception. +5 passive Investigation. Can read lips if you can see the creature's mouth and it is speaking a language you know. +1 INT or WIS.

features.name: Inspiring Leader
features.description: Spend 10 minutes speaking to up to 6 friendly creatures who can hear and understand you. Each gains temporary HP equal to your level + CHA modifier. Creatures cannot benefit again until they finish a short or long rest.
features.note: Must spend 10 minutes — plan before combat, not during.

features.name: Metamagic Adept
features.description: Gain 2 Sorcery Points per long rest. Learn two Metamagic options. Spend Sorcery Points to apply Metamagic to spells as normal.
features.note: Specify which two Metamagic options each character has chosen.

features.name: Slasher
features.description: +1 STR or DEX. On a hit with a slashing weapon: target's speed reduced by 10ft until start of your next turn. On a critical hit with a slashing weapon: target has disadvantage on attack rolls until start of your next turn.

features.name: Fey Touched
features.description: +1 INT, WIS, or CHA. Learn Misty Step and one 1st level divination or enchantment spell. Cast each once per long rest without a spell slot. Can also cast using spell slots.
features.note: Specify which 1st level spell each character chose.

features.name: Shadow Touched
features.description: +1 INT, WIS, or CHA. Learn Invisibility and one 1st level illusion or necromancy spell. Cast each once per long rest without a spell slot. Can also cast using spell slots.
features.note: Specify which 1st level spell each character chose.

features.name: Disarming Attack
features.description: Expend one Superiority Die. On a hit: add Superiority Die to damage. Target makes STR or DEX save (DC = 8 + proficiency + STR or DEX mod) or drops one held item of your choice.

features.name: Precision Attack
features.description: Expend one Superiority Die before the attack roll. Add the die to the attack roll. Can use after seeing the roll but before knowing if it hits.
features.note: Use this to turn near-misses into hits.

features.name: Riposte
features.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack: expend one Superiority Die as a reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature. On a hit: add Superiority Die to damage.

features.name: Menacing Attack
features.description: Expend one Superiority Die. On a hit: add Superiority Die to damage. Target makes WIS save (DC = 8 + proficiency + STR or DEX mod) or is frightened of you until end of your next turn.

features.name: Superiority Dice
features.description: Pool of d10s used to fuel Battle Master maneuvers. At level 7: 4 dice. Recharge on short or long rest.
features.note: Track current dice separately in active_effects or character sheet.

features.name: Agonizing Blast
features.description: Add CHA modifier to Eldritch Blast damage rolls. Applies to each beam separately.

features.name: Devil's Sight
features.description: See normally in darkness — both magical and nonmagical — to 120ft.
features.note: Pairs exceptionally well with Hunger of Hadar.

features.name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
features.description: Read all writing. Any language, any script, any surface. No action required.
features.note: Kerra has been using this quietly for years without mentioning it.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.description: When casting a spell using alchemist's supplies as a spellcasting focus: add INT modifier to one damage roll or to the amount of HP restored by the spell.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.description: After a long rest: produce a number of experimental elixirs equal to INT modifier. Roll d6 per elixir to determine effect: 1 Healing (2d4+2), 2 Swiftness (+10ft speed 1 hour), 3 Resilience (+1 AC 10 minutes), 4 Boldness (advantage on attack rolls and saves 1 minute), 5 Flight (fly speed 10ft 10 minutes), 6 Transformation (as Alter Self 10 minutes). Drinking is a bonus action.
features.note: Elixirs expire after a long rest if unused.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.description: When you or a creature within 30ft makes an ability check or saving throw: add INT modifier to the roll. Can use a number of times equal to INT modifier per long rest.

features.name: Tool Expertise
features.description: Proficiency bonus doubled for any ability check using a tool you are proficient with.

features.name: Insightful Fighting (Revised)
features.description: As a bonus action, make an Insight check contested by a target's Charisma/Deception check. On a success, you identify and vocally expose a weakness in the target's defense. While this effect is active: Sneak Attack applies to attacks against this target without requiring advantage or an adjacent ally. Any attack roll against this target, by anyone, whose d20 result equals the unmodified Insight die roll (or standard natural 20) is treated as a critical hit. If the Insight die result was a natural 20, critical hits against this target deal triple damage. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until successfully used against a different target.

features.name: Inquisitive — Steady Eye
features.description: Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks if you don't move more than half your speed on the same turn.

features.name: Inquisitive — Unerring Eye
features.description: Sense magical illusions, shapechanger in disguise, or other magical deception within 30ft. Not exact — you sense something is off, not necessarily what.

features.name: Scout — Skirmisher
features.description: When an enemy ends its turn within 5ft of you: move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Scout — Survivalist
features.description: Gain proficiency in Nature and Survival. Proficiency bonus doubled for these skills.

features.name: Scout — Superior Mobility
features.description: +10ft movement speed. If no armor worn, +10ft additionally.

features.name: Soulknife — Psychic Blades
features.description: Manifest a psychic blade as part of an attack. 1d6 psychic damage, finesse, thrown (60ft). Second blade as bonus action on same turn deals 1d4 psychic. No material component, appear and vanish instantly.

features.name: Soulknife — Psionic Energy
features.description: Pool of Psionic Energy dice (d6s). Used for Soul Blades, Psychic Whispers, Psychic Veil, and Psi-Bolstered Knack. Regain one die as bonus action once per short rest.
features.note: Track current dice in active_effects.

features.name: Soulknife — Psi-Bolstered Knack
features.description: When failing an ability check using a skill or tool proficiency: expend one Psionic Energy die and add it to the check, potentially turning failure into success.
features.note: Expend after seeing the roll.

features.name: Soulknife — Psychic Whispers
features.description: Expend one Psionic Energy die. Choose creatures equal to proficiency bonus. Telepathic link for a number of hours equal to die roll. Communicate silently at any range as long as on same plane.

features.name: Stars Druid — Starry Form
features.description: Transform into a starry form for 10 minutes. Choose constellation: Archer (bonus radiant damage on spells, 1d8+WIS as bonus action each turn), Chalice (healing spells heal Tackett for 1d8+WIS mod), Dragon (concentration checks auto-succeed on rolls of 9 or lower). Unbroken (legendary — see separate entry).

features.name: Stars Druid — Cosmic Omen
features.description: After a long rest roll a d6. Odd: Weal — use reaction to add 1d6 to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw of a creature within 30ft. Even: Woe — use reaction to subtract 1d6 from a roll of a creature within 30ft.
features.note: Roll at start of each long rest to determine Weal or Woe.

features.name: Stars Druid — Full of Stars
features.description: While in Starry Form: become partially incorporeal. Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

features.name: Stars Druid — Unbroken (Legendary)
features.description: Legendary fourth constellation. While active: can maintain concentration on two spells simultaneously, advantage on all concentration saving throws. Duration 10 minutes. Once per long rest.
features.note: Cannot stack with other Starry Form constellations — this replaces them for the duration.

features.name: Abjuration Wizard — Arcane Ward
features.description: When casting an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher: ward gains HP equal to twice spell level + INT modifier. Ward has max HP of twice wizard level + INT modifier. Damage to Lyria hits the ward first. Ward recharges when she casts abjuration spells.
features.note: Track ward HP separately.

features.name: Abjuration Wizard — Projected Ward
features.description: When a creature within 30ft takes damage: expend the Arcane Ward to absorb damage for that creature instead of Lyria.
features.note: Ward is consumed — must recharge before using again.

features.name: Abjuration Wizard — Improved Abjuration
features.description: Add proficiency bonus to ability checks made as part of casting Counterspell or Dispel Magic.

features.name: Abjuration Wizard — Spell Resistance
features.description: Advantage on saving throws against spells. Resistance to spell damage.

features.name: Tempest Cleric — Wrath of the Storm
features.description: When a creature within 5ft hits you: use reaction to deal 2d8 lightning or thunder damage. Target makes DEX save (spell save DC) for half.

features.name: Tempest Cleric — Destructive Wrath
features.description: When rolling lightning or thunder damage: replace any roll with maximum damage instead of rolling.
features.note: Uses Channel Divinity.

features.name: Tempest Cleric — Thunderbolt Strike
features.description: When dealing lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature: push it up to 10ft away.

features.name: Stone's Endurance
features.description: When you take damage: use reaction to reduce damage by 1d12 + CON modifier.
features.note: Goliath racial feature.

features.name: Bountiful Luck
features.description: When an ally within 30ft rolls a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw: use reaction to let them reroll. They must use the new roll.
features.note: Halfling racial feat. Does not cost Tackett's Lucky feature.

features.name: Vow of the Open Road
features.description: Details not fully specified — confirm with DM.
features.note: Homebrew. Fill in when details confirmed.

features.name: Inquisitive — Ear for Deceit
features.description: Gain proficiency in Insight. Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

features.name: Inquisitive — Eye for Detail
features.description: Use a bonus action to take the Search action, or to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden creature or object, or an Intelligence (Investigation) check to uncover or decipher clues.

features.name: Scout — Ambush Master
features.description: Advantage on initiative rolls. Creatures you hit during the first round of combat become easier targets — each ally has advantage on attack rolls against them until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.description: Use the Help action as a bonus action. When you use Help to aid an ally attacking a creature, the target can be within 30ft rather than 5ft.

features.name: Blessed Strikes
features.description: When your weapon attack or cantrip damages a creature, you can expend a use of Divine Strike or Potent Spellcasting (whichever you have) to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage to the target. You can use this benefit only once per turn.
features.note: Optional class feature from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything, replaces Divine Strike.

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.description: As an action, expend one use of Channel Divinity to imbue one weapon you are holding with positive energy. For 1 minute: add CHA modifier to attack rolls (minimum +1), weapon counts as magical, emits bright light in 20ft radius and dim light 20ft beyond.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you are at your deadliest when you get the drop on your enemies. You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. In addition, any hit you score against a creature that is surprised is a critical hit.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.description:
At 3rd level, you master the art of the ambush. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Wisdom modifier.

At the start of your first turn of each combat, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, which lasts until the end of that turn. If you take the Attack action on that turn, you can make one additional weapon attack as part of that action. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's damage type.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision from your race, its range increases by 30 feet.

You are also adept at evading creatures that rely on darkvision. While in darkness, you are invisible to any creature that relies on darkvision to see you in that darkness.

features.name: Tattoo of Warding
features.description: Once per long rest, as a reaction, you may completely block one incoming ranged attack — negating all damage and effects from that attack. The tattoo is inscribed on the sword arm and activates instinctively.
features.source: Campaign homebrew

features.name: Divine Magic
features.description: Divine Soul Sorcerer feature. You have access to the full Cleric spell list in addition to the Sorcerer spell list. When you learn a Sorcerer spell, you may choose from either list.
features.source: Divine Soul (Sorcerer subclass)

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.description: Divine Soul Sorcerer feature. When you fail a saving throw or miss with an attack roll, you can roll 2d4 and add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome. Once used, cannot be used again until you finish a short or long rest.
features.source: Divine Soul (Sorcerer subclass)

features.name: Empowered Healing
features.description: Divine Soul Sorcerer feature. When you or an ally within 5 feet of you rolls dice to determine hit points restored by a spell, you may spend 1 sorcery point to reroll any number of those dice once, taking the new result.
features.source: Divine Soul (Sorcerer subclass)

features.name: Weave Embodiment
features.description: Once per long rest, cast your CURRENT phase's level-1 grid spell without expending a spell slot: Shield (Leno), Silvery Barbs (Twill), Color Spray (Satin). To access another phase's free cast, first switch into it with Mother's Whim (1 SP) — up to 3 free casts per long rest total (one per phase) if you pay to cycle through all three.
features.source: Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass) — reskin of Lunar Sorcery's Lunar Embodiment. Mechanically identical to RAW (a free cast of your current phase's spell; reaching another phase's free cast requires paying to shift into it first).

features.name: Loom Fire
features.description: You know Sacred Flame (doesn't count against cantrips known). When you cast it, you may target one creature as normal OR target two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other, each making its own DEX save.
features.source: Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass) — reskin of Lunar Sorcery's Moon Fire, mechanically identical.

features.name: Mother's Whim
features.description: Two separate effects bundled into one feature. (1) Shifting: as a bonus action, spend 1 Sorcery Point to change your active Weave Phase to a different one (Leno/Twill/Satin) — costs 1 SP every time you shift, no cap on the number of shifts beyond available SP. (2) Discount: whenever you apply Metamagic to a spell belonging to your CURRENT phase's school pair, reduce its SP cost by 1 (minimum 0). Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest, refreshing on a long rest — independent of how many times you've shifted phase.
features.source: Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass) — reskin combining Lunar Sorcery's Waxing and Waning and Lunar Boons into a single named feature. Numbers unchanged from RAW.

features.name: Leno Phase (Abjuration / Divination)
features.description: Active phase: 1 SP discount on Metamagic for Abjuration and Divination spells (see Mother's Whim). All five grid spells for this phase are always known and prepared regardless of which phase is currently active — cast any of them normally with a spell slot of the appropriate level, exactly like any other prepared spell. Only the level-1 spell's free (no-slot) cast is phase-gated (see Weave Embodiment). Grid: Shield (1st), Lesser Restoration (2nd), Dispel Magic (3rd), Death Ward (4th), Rary's Telepathic Bond (5th).
features.source: Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass) — reskin of Lunar Sorcery's Full Moon phase. Identical to official in every grid slot — a pure rename, no spell substitutions.

features.name: Twill Phase (Enchantment / Necromancy)
features.description: Active phase: 1 SP discount on Metamagic for Enchantment and Necromancy spells (see Mother's Whim). All five grid spells for this phase are always known and prepared regardless of which phase is currently active — cast any of them normally with a spell slot of the appropriate level, exactly like any other prepared spell. Only the level-1 spell's free (no-slot) cast is phase-gated (see Weave Embodiment). Grid: Silvery Barbs (1st), Blindness/Deafness (2nd), Vampiric Touch (3rd), Confusion (4th), Synaptic Static (5th).
features.source: Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass) — reskin of Lunar Sorcery's New Moon phase. School pairing matches the final published subclass exactly (Evocation, present in the 2022 Unearthed Arcana: Heroes of Krynn playtest pairing, was deliberately dropped when this subclass was built, to avoid stacking cheap Metamagic on an already blast-heavy school). Two of five grid slots (1st and 5th) were deliberately reselected within the Enchantment/Necromancy pairing rather than kept at RAW's defaults (Ray of Sickness and Hold Monster) — an intentional house-rule choice under this subclass's grid-selection rule, not an error.

features.name: Satin Phase (Illusion / Transmutation)
features.description: Active phase: 1 SP discount on Metamagic for Illusion and Transmutation spells (see Mother's Whim). All five grid spells for this phase are always known and prepared regardless of which phase is currently active — cast any of them normally with a spell slot of the appropriate level, exactly like any other prepared spell. Only the level-1 spell's free (no-slot) cast is phase-gated (see Weave Embodiment). Grid: Color Spray (1st), Alter Self (2nd), Phantom Steed (3rd), Fabricate (4th), Telekinesis (5th).
features.source: Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass) — reskin of Lunar Sorcery's Crescent Moon phase. School pairing matches official exactly. Two of five grid slots (4th and 5th) were deliberately reselected within the Illusion/Transmutation pairing rather than kept at RAW's defaults (Hallucinatory Terrain and Mislead). The 5th slot was originally set to Far Step, but Far Step is Conjuration and doesn't belong to either of this phase's schools — it was swapped for Telekinesis (Transmutation), and Far Step moved to the character's ordinary known-spell list instead.

features.name: Weave Empowerment
features.description: Passive, tied to your currently active phase. Leno: as a bonus action, your markings blaze — shed bright light in a 10ft radius and dim light 10ft beyond; you and creatures of your choice within that light gain advantage on Investigation and Perception checks. Twill: advantage on Stealth checks; while you are entirely in an area of darkness, attack rolls against you have disadvantage. Satin: resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.
features.source: Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass) — reskin of Lunar Sorcery's Lunar Empowerment (14th level). Flavor-only skin, prepared ahead of when it's needed; mechanically identical to RAW. Not yet unlocked on any character.

features.name: Unraveling
features.description: Bonus action, usable once per long rest (or spend 5 Sorcery Points to use it again), and can be combined with a Mother's Whim phase shift. Leno: 30ft radius burst of unweaving light — each creature in the area makes a CON save or is blinded until the end of its next turn; choose one creature in range to regain 3d8 hit points. Twill: 30ft radius burst of unraveling shadow-thread — each creature in the area makes a DEX save or takes 3d10 necrotic damage and has its speed reduced to 0; you become invisible until the end of your next turn. Satin: the Weave folds — teleport up to 60ft to an unoccupied space you can see, bringing one willing creature within 5ft of you along; you and that creature gain resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.
features.source: Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass) — reskin of Lunar Sorcery's Lunar Phenomenon (18th level capstone). Flavor-only skin, prepared ahead of when it's needed; mechanically identical to RAW. Not yet unlocked on any character.

features.name: Manifest Echo
features.description: As a bonus action, manifest an echo of yourself — a translucent gray image — in an unoccupied space you can see within 15ft. Echo stats: AC 14 + your proficiency bonus, 1 HP, immune to all conditions, uses your saving throws, same size as you. It lasts until destroyed, until dismissed as a bonus action, until you manifest another echo, until you're incapacitated, or until it ends your turn more than 30ft from you. While it exists you also have access to Echo: Reposition, Echo: Swap Places, Echo: Attack From, and Echo: Opportunity Attack.
features.source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — 3rd level. Split into separate entries below so each shows up correctly under the action/bonus action/reaction filter instead of being buried as prose inside one feature.

features.name: Echo: Reposition
features.description: No action required — while your echo exists, mentally move it up to 30ft in any direction, any number of times on your turn. It's destroyed if it ends your turn more than 30ft from you.
features.source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — part of Manifest Echo, 3rd level.

features.name: Echo: Swap Places
features.description: As a bonus action, teleport-swap positions with your echo, regardless of the distance between you. Costs 15ft of your movement for that turn in addition to the bonus action.
features.source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — part of Manifest Echo, 3rd level.

features.name: Echo: Attack From
features.description: When you take the Attack action, each attack you make as part of it can originate from your own space or your echo's space, chosen individually per attack. No extra action cost — a targeting option within the Attack action itself, distinct from Unleash Incarnation's separate bonus attack.
features.source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — part of Manifest Echo, 3rd level.
features.table_ruling: RAW is genuinely ambiguous about how far 'the attack originates from the echo's space' extends. Locked in as the table ruling: for a standard attack made this way, it only affects range/targeting for that attack — the character's real body stays where it actually is for every other purpose (reach against them, opportunity attacks against them, etc.). Contrast with Unleash Incarnation below, which is ruled differently.

features.name: Echo: Opportunity Attack
features.description: When a creature you can see within 5ft of your echo moves at least 5ft away from it, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack against that creature as if you were standing in the echo's space.
features.source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — part of Manifest Echo, 3rd level.

features.name: Unleash Incarnation
features.description: Whenever you take the Attack action, you can make one additional melee attack from your echo's position. Usable a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum once), regaining all expended uses on a long rest.
features.source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — 3rd level.
features.table_ruling: Ruled differently from Echo: Attack From's standard attacks: this genuinely treats the character as positioned at the echo for that one attack, full stop — not just range/targeting, but for any purpose that specific attack would care about.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.description: If you make a melee attack against a creature on your turn, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.
features.source: Swashbuckler (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 3rd level.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.description: You gain a bonus to your Initiative rolls equal to your Charisma modifier. In addition, you don't need advantage on the attack roll to use Sneak Attack against a creature if you're within 5ft of it, no other creature is within 5ft of you, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll — this replaces the normal Sneak Attack requirement of advantage or an ally adjacent to the target.
features.source: Swashbuckler (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 3rd level.

features.name: Elven Accuracy
features.description: Prerequisite: Elf or half-elf. Increase Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1 (max 20). Whenever you have advantage on an attack roll using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice once.
features.source: Feat, Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
features.source: Elf / Half-Elf racial trait.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: You can see in dim light within 60ft as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray. Range may vary by race — check the character's own darkvision field for their actual range.
features.source: Common racial trait (Elf, Half-Elf, Dwarf, Tiefling, Aasimar, and others). Registered generically since the mechanic is identical across races; only the range occasionally differs.

weapon_types.name: Saber
weapon_types.notes: 30 gp, 4 lb. This elegant weapon is most famously wielded by duelists and swashbucklers. Anyone proficient with a rapier can proficiently wield a saber.

weapon_types.name: Yetgrese Throwing Sword
weapon_types.notes: Weighted to serve equally as a melee or thrown weapon. Uses the same damage die in both modes.

races.name: Catrin
races.appearance: Taller and broader than humans. Squared facial features. Mottled and ridged skin along lower jaw and chin instead of facial hair. Skin tones similar to human range but extending further into pink and yellow. Culturally tend toward very long hair.

traits.name: Broad Build
traits.description: Counts as one size larger for the purposes of carrying capacity and grappling.

traits.name: Settled Presence
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.

traits.name: Brace
traits.description: As a reaction when hit by a melee attack, halve the damage and push the attacker 5ft away if they are Medium or smaller.

races.notes: Majority population of Yetgrese's exterior coast.

races.name: Drevani
races.appearance: Humanoid pomeranian appearance. Average height 2.5 feet. Expressive faces, full fur covering. Tilawam subculture tends toward punk aesthetic — leather, piercings, dramatically dyed fur, shaved patches for tattoos.

traits.name: Sharp Nose
traits.description: Advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Low Profile
traits.description: Can move through the space of Medium or larger creatures without squeezing.

traits.name: Ferocious Bite
traits.description: Make an unarmed strike as a bonus action dealing piercing damage plus STR modifier. Damage die scales every 3 levels: levels 1-2: 1d6, levels 3-5: 2d6, levels 6-8: 3d6, levels 9-11: 4d6, levels 12-14: 5d6, levels 15-17: 6d6, levels 18-20: 7d6.

races.notes: Found in lower altitude regions of Yetgrese.

races.name: Hei'ugar
races.appearance: Grey-undertoned skin, warmer than standard Duergar after generations of surface living. More varied hair than their Duergar kin. Enlarged pupils adapted to both darkness and daylight. Stocky, durable build.

traits.name: Grey Resilience
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against illusions, charm, and paralysis.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Can see in dim light within 60ft as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. Cannot discern color in darkness.

traits.name: Gust of Wind
traits.description: Cast Gust of Wind once per long rest without requiring a spell slot or material components.

traits.name: Far Sight
traits.description: Advantage on Perception checks targeting creatures or objects 60ft or further away.

races.notes: Duergar who left the underdark and settled on Yetgrese's surface generations ago. Named Hei'ugar meaning roughly Sky Duergar. Treat the open sky as sacred, bordering on religious. Predominantly farmers and fishermen living on Tilawam's outskirts. Approximately 5% of Tilawam's population.

races.name: Dhovari
races.location: Northern Fynesmarch, Olwood Verge forest — encountered on western interior route near ridge ruins
races.appearance: Bipedal, digitigrade legs, six to seven feet tall. Broad through chest and shoulders. Patterned fur-feather covering that lies flat when calm and raises when alert — darker along spine and shoulders, lighter at throat and chest. Forward-facing luminescent eyes. Hands with four long flexible fingers, hardened dark fingertips.
races.language: Tonal and layered — chest and throat operating simultaneously. Rendered through Helm of Comprehending Languages; pronunciation uncertain.
races.personality_traits: Patient, hierarchical, deliberate. Think before speaking as deep habit. Not demonstrative but not cold.
races.notes: Ancestors co-built the ridge complex with another civilization before a forgetting severed the connection. Eleven generations carrying one quarter of a broken disc. Three encountered — a speaker, a large one, and a younger one still growing into itself. They knew where every party member was positioned at all times. Compliment Pirra and Siv's instincts specifically. Return to ridge ruins at spring equinox dawn with disc and scroll. Statue from the ruins box depicts them — was made to be found.

languages.name: Solvalean
languages.description: The official language of the Solvale Empire.

rules.name: Critical Hits
rules.description: On a critical hit, double the total damage of the attack after all modifiers are applied, rather than doubling the damage dice only.
rules.notes: Implemented because crits don't feel rewarding or powerful.

rules.name: Critical Fail on Saving Throws
rules.description: A natural 1 on a saving throw results in double damage taken, rather than just a failed save.
rules.notes: Applies to both enemy and player saving throws for consistency.

rules.name: Critical Roll Consequences
rules.description: A natural 1 or natural 20 carries an additional consequence beyond automatic failure or success, at the DM's discretion. On a critical 1 attack roll, the attacker typically disarms themselves. On a critical 20, the consequence is a dramatic positive outcome suited to the moment — not just a hit, but something memorable. The nature of the consequence should fit the fiction and scale with the stakes.
rules.notes: Keeps the extremes of the dice meaningful and dramatic in both directions. The DM has full latitude to interpret the consequence; consistency matters more than strict rules.

rules.name: Stealth Awareness
rules.description: While Hidden, a character gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice hidden creatures or objects, and on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to find traps.
rules.notes: From Solasta. Moving carefully and quietly also means moving attentively. Rewards players who choose stealth as a playstyle beyond just avoiding detection.

rules.name: Spell Material Components
rules.description: Material components (M) are not required to cast spells. In their place, spellcasters may use Weave Dust — a fine crystalline powder that serves as a universal substitute for all material components. Weave Dust can be purchased from alchemists, magic shops, and certain temples, or produced by breaking down traditional spell components or certain animal parts through a distillation process. The spell's original material cost roughly dictates how much dust is required. Dust is stored in small capsules, almost excluisvely made of silver, that hold enough for a simple spell. Weave Dust is sold in small vials and larger pouches; exact pricing varies by region but is generally 'per capsule'.
rules.notes: Introduced to streamline play. Hunting for obscure specific components is more friction than fun at this table. Characters must still buy or otherwise procure the powder..

rules.name: Caster Prestidigitation
rules.description: All arcane and divine casters receive a free, flavor-appropriate form of Prestidigitation that does not count against their spell allotment. Sorcerers and Wizards receive standard Prestidigitation. Druids receive standard Druidcraft. Clerics receive Divine Prestidigitation (a divine-flavored equivalent). Warlocks receive Dark Prestidigitation (a patron-flavored equivalent that does not draw from the Weave). These spells are always prepared and cannot be removed.
rules.notes: Casters should feel like casters without spending a cantrip slot on it. Mages wave their hand and make a small change in the world; druids make a flower bloom. These spells are the mechanical expression of that identity.

subclasses.name: Weave Attunement
subclasses.source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen (2023, final published version)
subclasses.lineage_notes: Weave Attunement is a direct mechanical reskin of the official Lunar Sorcery sorcerous origin — moon phases become Weave phases, moon/celestial imagery becomes fabric-and-loom imagery tied to Ne'auveothrin, ancient demigod of the Weave. Two of the three phases (Leno = Full Moon, Satin = Crescent Moon) use school pairings identical to the final published subclass. The third (Twill = New Moon) also matches the final published pairing (Enchantment + Necromancy) rather than the earlier Unearthed Arcana: Heroes of Krynn (2022) playtest pairing of Evocation + Necromancy — Evocation was deliberately excluded when this subclass was built, to avoid stacking cheap Metamagic discounts on top of an already blast-heavy school. That choice happens to match what the final published book independently settled on too.
house_rules: Grid spell selection is not locked to RAW's fixed table. At each phase/level slot, any spell of the correct level from one of that phase's two associated schools may be chosen in place of the RAW default. Every substitution made for Iyani follows this rule — see each Phase feature's entry in the features catalog above for exactly which slots were changed and why.
subclasses.notes: Levels 14 and 18 features already exist in the features catalog as flavor-ready placeholders — mechanically identical to RAW Lunar Empowerment / Lunar Phenomenon, just renamed. Not yet added to any character's sheet; add them (and update the character's own feature list) once a Weave Attunement sorcerer actually reaches that level.
